Lecture Overview:
Which framework should you use to build AI agents? In this Stanford CS329Z: Engineering AI Agents lecture, DSPy contributor Michael Ryan live-codes agents in DSPy (signatures, modules, and optimizers) and LangGraph (state, nodes, and edges), then compares open-source agent harnesses like mini-SWE-agent, OpenHands, and Pi, shows durable orchestration with Temporal, and shares best practices for observability and evals.
Speaker: Michael Ryan
